source_instruction: i am looking for a individual wrapped birthday cakes and chocolate chip blondies that come in a 12 pack.
query: Ugh, you won’t believe what just happened by the front entrance two minutes ago! That golden retriever that’s always napping tied to the bike rack out front broke free when a squirrel darted past, bolted straight into the sample table by the produce department, and sent little cups of mango salsa flying everywhere. The poor sample lady was laughing so hard she could barely stand up, half the people nearby were handing the dog tiny bits of tortilla chip instead of chasing him, and I swear he ate three full cups of salsa before his owner caught him, tail wagging like he’d just won the best prize of the whole day. I even stopped to help wipe salsa off a little kid’s rain boot that got splattered, and the kid just kept saying the dog was “the best party ever” so that totally made my whole trip worth it before I even started grabbing what we need. Hey, I’m grabbing stuff over in the dairy, cheese & eggs section right now. I need those treats that come individually wrapped, y’know the ones, and make sure they’re certified kosher for Passover too, right? Don’t go over that one for the total cost, yeah? Oh, and grab the kind we always pick for the party, you know the flavors, don’t mess that up. Wait, make sure none of the packages are crushed either when you pull ’em off the shelf.
